alex: Heads-up — enterprise customer (acct 789) flagged an invoice ~11.8k tokens higher than their SDK estimator. They say they only sent ~1.2k tokens. Any ideas? :thinking:

priya: Can you paste the request payload or SDK snippet? streaming? functions? tools?

alex: Yep. Here's what they sent (JS SDK):

alex: ```js
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'redwood-oss-1',
  input: [
    {role: 'system', content: 'You are an assistant.'},
    {role: 'user', content: 'Summarize dataset.'}
  ],
  functions: [{name: 'summarize_file', /* omitted */ }],
  stream: true
})
```

alex: They also use a sidecar tool that returns a long blob as a tool response after the function call. SDK estimator shows ~1.2k tokens but metering shows ~13k.

metering-bot: metering: invoice event: 2026-03-10T12:03:00Z acct=789 tokens=13820 reason=usage

sasha: We saw similar earlier — sidecar tool outputs are added by the runtime as role=tool (or role=system) after function return; the client-side SDK estimator only counts provided messages + predicted assistant chunks and misses tool tokens emitted server-side. :grimacing:

jin: Repro steps I'd try:
1) call with `stream:true` and `functions` set
2) have tool emit a long streamed response (~10k tokens)
3) compare websocket events vs /v1/usage entries

jin: Quick curl repro I used: 

jin: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-oss-1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are help."},{"role":"user","content":"Make long summary"}],"functions":[{"name":"f"}],"stream":true}'
```

priya: Root cause (short): SDK estimator tokenizes only the client-visible input + predicted assistant output. Tokens injected by the serving runtime (tool outputs or post-function system messages streamed back) are produced server-side and are billed but not seen by the estimator.

sasha: Billing ops — can we add a dashboard note and offer a one-off credit for affected enterprise customers? This one is on an annual commit.

sasha: I'll loop in finance (cc @billing-ops) and offer temporary credit while eng ships an SDK mitigation.

alex: Customer is okay with a credit if we can explain cause and timeline. ETA for SDK patch?

priya: We can ship an SDK patch in ~72 hours that optionally requests a post-run token summary header `x-sdk-metering-hint: include_tool_tokens=true`. Full rollout and docs in ~2 weeks. Short-term mitigation: set `stream:false` or run a server-side token-count of any tool output before returning it to the client.

jin: I'll open a bug/PR and link here — PR: rwd/sdk#4321 (WIP). I'll also add a reproducible test that streams a 10k-token tool response.

alex: Thanks — please keep me posted, I'll notify the customer. :thumbsup:

metering-bot: note: created usage investigation ticket UI-4589
